ppo_training_episode_seeds.sampling_rule: Each model seed drives an independent reproducible RNG stream within this training-only range.

allowed_uses: Rolling MILP horizon and time-limit smoke validation

formal_test.access_status: unvisited holdout test set for future frozen controllers
formal_test.access_rule: future controllers may be evaluated only after their method, checkpoint, gate, budget and reporting choices are frozen; this range must not be used for any further selection

deprecated_formal_test.reason: superseded by manifest version 4 for future controller comparisons
prohibited_actions: use for model or hyperparameter selection

legacy_development_only.reason: already used by unified-window comparisons and reproducibility evaluations before the paper protocol was frozen

split_rules: formal test seeds must not be used for training, root generation, hyperparameter selection, checkpoint selection or debugging
controller validation seeds must not appear in the formal test range
Low, Medium and High stress evaluations reuse the same formal test seed numbers to preserve pairing
all future controller comparisons use the revised formal test range only after controller configuration is frozen
deprecated formal-test results remain archived and identifiable in provenance records
